channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Grugan aiming to be back for Armagh's championship campaign
item.description: Armagh forward Rory Grugan says he hopes to be back available for selection for the Orchard men's championship campaign which commences against Tyrone next month.

item.title: Cork not looking beyond Limerick clash - O'Connor
item.description: Cork boss Ben O'Connor says his team are not looking beyond this Saturday evening's showdown against Limerick at the TUS Gaelic Grounds (7pm).

item.title: Daingean Uí Chúis dominate Club Football Team of the Year
item.description: The GAA have announced the AIB GAA Football Club Championship Team of the Year.

item.title: Antrim on the up again on Dowds' second coming
item.description: Elaine Dowds would love to start International Women's Day on Sunday morning with a warm glow of victory still coursing through her veins.

item.title: Nash returns to Limerick defence
item.description: Limerick boss John Kiely has named his side for tomorrow evening's Allianz Hurling League clash against Cork at the TUS Gaelic Grounds (7pm).

item.title: "It is now rare to see a true 50:50 ball played in"
item.description: Former Tipperary star Shane McGrath believes the game of hurling has never been played faster and by athletes in such condition as it has been in recent times.

item.title: "You're only as good as your next game" - Meenagh
item.description: Derry manager Ciaran Meenagh says his side are staying focused on themselves as they look to push for promotion back to Division 1 in the Allianz Football League's remaining two rounds.

item.title: McGrath keen for Tipp to bounce back after "reality check"
item.description: Tipperary star John McGrath says the Premier men are eager to return to winning ways after their "reality check" against Limerick two weeks ago.

item.title: Sheridan to miss Carlow clash after red card upheld
item.description: Kildare ace Jack Sheridan is set to miss Sunday's Allianz Hurling League Division 1B clash against Carlow after having an appeal against his red card rejected.

item.title: GAA on TV: Allianz Hurling League comes into focus this weekend with five games to watch live
item.description: The Allianz Hurling League takes centre stage this weekend with five games available for fans to watch live.
